_about: Codes from the SAM wiki checked by Claude on 2026-10-21 by searching the WHO browsers. 'exists' = the code was found with this title. Fit (whether the code is the right one for the advice) is a separate, human question.

7A60.wikiTitle: Circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder, delayed sleep phase type

7A61.wikiTitle: Circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder, advanced sleep phase type

notConfirmed.7A00: Chronic insomnia. Exists; not used by the wiki. A more specific option than 7A0Z for the insomnia-treatment items (CBT-I, sleep restriction, stimulus control).

icd11.fitNote: ICD-11 codes name disorders. Most items are general advice for people without a disorder, so the codes say which condition an item is relevant to, not what the advice is. The wiki assigns 7A0Z (insomnia, unspecified) to whole subcategories such as bedroom environment; that is a loose fit.

ichi.release: WHO-FIC maintenance platform (work-in-progress version, not a released version)

ATK.PG.ZZ.currentTitle: Assisting and leading exercise for sleep functions

alsoAvailable.ATK.PN.ZZ: Advising about sleep functions. Possibly the best single fit for a list of advice.
alsoAvailable.ATK.AN.ZZ: Interview in relation to sleep functions
alsoAvailable.ATK.ZZ.ZZ: Other interventions on sleep functions, not elsewhere classified

ichi.fitNote: ICHI codes describe the intervention (education, advising, exercise). The wiki assigns one per category; category 2 (light, diet, breathing) gets ATK.PG.ZZ 'assisting and leading exercise', which fits the exercise and breathing items but not light or diet.
